title: Butterworth order estimate
prompt: Implement `butter_order(wp, ws, rp_db, rs_db)` returning ceil of Butterworth analog order N = log(eps_s/eps_p)/log(ws/wp) with eps from ripples. Return int >=1.
public_tests_hint:
- ws>wp → finite N
- stricter stopband → higher N
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    n1=solution.butter_order(1.0,2.0,1.0,20.0)
    n2=solution.butter_order(1.0,2.0,1.0,40.0)
    assert n1>=1 and n2>=n1
